name: application-mini-stat-chip
title: Mini Stat Chip
description: Compact inline label+value+trend micro-stat pill sized for toolbars — distinct from stat-tile, which is a full padded card rather than an inline chip. Trend arrow direction and color are derived from the real sign of a numeric trend percentage.
useWhen: Surfacing one or more key metrics inline within a toolbar or dense header row.
You need a trend indicator without the visual weight of a full stat-tile card.
Several mini stats need to sit side-by-side in a constrained horizontal space.
avoidWhen: You need a standalone, prominent KPI card with more visual weight — use stat-tile instead.
The metric has no trend to show — omit the trend segment rather than showing a static 0%.
You need an icon or multi-line description alongside the stat — a full card is more appropriate.
responsiveBehavior: Each chip sizes to its content and wraps naturally in a flex container; multiple chips can sit inline until they overflow to a new line.
accessibility: The trend arrow's direction and color both derive from the same signed trendPercent value, so they can never contradict each other.
A visually-hidden 'Up'/'Down' label precedes the percentage so screen readers announce direction, not just a number.
Label and value are always plain text, never conveyed only through chip color.

variants.title: Mini stat chip
variants.description: Three toolbar chips (active users trending up, error rate trending down, and uptime with no trend), on a light surface.
accessibility: The uptime chip omits the trend segment entirely rather than rendering a misleading 0% arrow.

variants.title: Mini stat chip (Dark)
variants.description: The same three toolbar chips, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Trend colors meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
